name: agentimportmemory
description: Provides capabilities for agents to import and manage various types of memory (text, JSON, code, files) into their operational context.
author: Your Name <your.email@example.com>

capabilities.name: import_text_memory
capabilities.description: Imports raw text content into the agent's memory.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The text content to be imported.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional context or tag for the memory.

returns.description: An object indicating success/failure and any relevant IDs or status.

capabilities.name: import_json_memory
capabilities.description: Imports structured JSON data into the agent's memory.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The JSON object to be imported.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional JSON schema for validating the imported data.

returns.description: An object indicating success/failure and any relevant IDs or status.

capabilities.name: import_code_snippet
capabilities.description: Imports a code snippet into the agent's memory for reference.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The programming language of the code (e.g., 'javascript', 'python').

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: An optional description or purpose of the code snippet.

returns.description: An object indicating success/failure and any relevant IDs or status.
